description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007 Order under Section 5 (Special Commodity Levy as 200 per Kg. on Importation of Dates)
reasoning: This gazette content is an order made under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, which involves regulatory matters and legal authority. It modifies the application of an existing levy through statutory powers, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe is incidental to the exercise of legal authority under the Act, not the primary focus of the gazette.
